title: [CQ-I06d] JetBrains approval error correlation
description:
Objective: make the JetBrains plan review consume daemon ERROR frames the way VS Code's PlanReviewPanel.handleClientError does. Verified on 2026-10-30:
- MoeMessageDispatcher keeps only `message` and `operation` from an ERROR frame. It drops the frame's `codeName` and `context.taskId`.
- PlanReviewDialog.onError feeds EVERY error frame into PlanReviewApprovalState.onDaemonError, which re-arms a PENDING approval.

So any unrelated error that arrives while an approval is pending re-arms the dialog with a misleading 'The daemon refused the approval: <other text>'. Examples: another operation, another task, or a payload error with no context. When WORKING then arrives at the captured revision, it is reported as status-changed, never as approved. VS Code ignores uncorrelated frames, and latches on a correlated PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH. CQ-I06 DoD 1 ('Both clients consume identical daemon verdicts') needs one behaviour.

Deliverable:
- The dispatcher strictly parses `codeName` and `context.taskId`: strings only, anything else becomes null.
- It publishes them through a NEW default MoeStateListener method, so the four existing onError(operation, message) implementers stay unchanged.
- The dialog reacts only to operation APPROVE_TASK whose context.taskId equals its task:
  - a correlated PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH latches INVALIDATED with PLAN_CHANGED_KEY;
  - any other correlated error re-arms with DAEMON_ERROR_KEY, as today.
- Tests for each case.

Out of scope:
- the daemon frame shape, which already carries operation, code, codeName and context {taskId, epicId, revisions};
- VS Code, CLIENT_HELLO, and the shared verdict corpus (CQ-I06b);
- any other listener's error handling.

Verification (run fresh, exit 0 required): cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test. WSL has no JDK, so run the Windows gradlew.bat equivalent under the jetbrains-gradle lease and label it as such.
definitionOfDone: A dispatcher test feeds raw ERROR frames to MoeMessageDispatcher. The new listener method receives the exact operation, codeName and context.taskId. A missing or non-string codeName or taskId arrives as null. Existing onError(operation, message) delivery is unchanged.

Named PlanReviewApprovalStateTest cases: a PENDING approval stays PENDING after an ERROR for another operation, after one for another task, and after one with no context. A later WORKING at the captured revision then reaches FINISHED.

Named tests: a correlated PLAN_REVISION_MISMATCH while PENDING ends INVALIDATED with PLAN_CHANGED_KEY and never re-arms. Any other correlated codeName (including none) re-arms READY with DAEMON_ERROR_KEY.
Fresh `cd moe-jetbrains && ./gradlew test` exits 0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: JetBrains only: no daemon, wire-shape or moe-vscode changes; existing onError(operation, message) implementers keep compiling and behaving unchanged.

  This matches VS Code PlanReviewPanel.handleClientError.
- PlanReviewDialog drops its onError override and adds onDaemonError(error), with the same bounded message and EDT repaint.
